releaseNotes.content: Download update: includes preview.png to view the theme before installing. The preview is excluded from ETHOS Suite's installed files; radio code and artwork are unchanged. Readability update: improved foreground contrast and refreshed catalog previews. ETHOS 26.1 compatibility update, checked against the 26.1.2 theme API. Suite local ZIP layout corrected with the manifest and files at archive root. Unsupported firmware skips registration; optional toolbar load failures during initialization fall back to the theme colors. Requires ETHOS 26.1.0 or newer. Radio validation is still required. First release. Warm charcoal and copper with fine etched contours and concentric metal rings. Automatically selects 464x50 artwork on standard X18 radios and 784x50 artwork on 800px radios. Palette-matched transparent ETHOS header logo. Continuous toolbar materials and accents preserve the theme's style without a blank logo panel; prominent motifs sit clear of the lettering.
